verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say you can issue Visa debit or credit cards, set spend limits, and define roles (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-26), and up to 50 physical or virtual debit cards to your team (relay-docs-16), backed by role-based team access (relay-docs-31). Independent sources confirm physical cards with per-card limits (relay-comm-4), and the support docs cover physical card replacement (relay-docs-8). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that credit cards (not just debit) come in physical form, and in-depth first-party documentation of how card roles and permissions are configured for employees.
